instruction: Save the opened presentation as a BMP image file named slide.bmp on the Desktop. Apply default export settings.

metadata.explanation: Checks if the BMP export exists and has minimum size of 50KB. BMP is an uncompressed format, typically larger than PNG/JPG. Verified: BMP files are larger due to lack of compression.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator only checks file existence and size, but does NOT verify the file is actually in BMP format
Cannot distinguish between a correctly exported BMP and any file named 'slide.bmp' that is >=50KB
Missing file format validation - should check magic bytes or file header to confirm BMP format
The getter and metric logic work correctly for what they check (existence + size), but this is insufficient for complete verification
Could pass for wrong file formats (PNG, JPG, etc.) renamed to .bmp extension
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add BMP format validation by checking file magic bytes (should start with 'BM' for BMP files)
Update getter to read first 2 bytes of file and verify BMP signature
Update metric to check format validation in addition to existence and size
Consider adding basic image dimension checks to verify it's a valid image export
